AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Pocket Casts is a podcast player. These functions find podcasts and episodes, control playback, and manage the Up Next queue, the ordered list of episodes that play next. Operational patterns: - IDs are resolved in two steps: 'searchPodcasts' returns podcast IDs, and 'findEpisodes' returns episode IDs for 'playEpisode', 'addToUpNext', 'downloadEpisode' and 'starEpisode'. - When the user says 'this episode', call 'getUpNext' first and use its current episode ID. - To summarise an episode or answer questions about what was said, read it with 'getTranscript'. To jump to a topic, find its time in 'getEpisodeDetails' chapters or 'getTranscript' lines, then call 'seekTo'. - For a spoken-style request such as 'play the latest episode of X', call 'playPodcast' once instead of searching, finding and playing separately. - 'searchPodcasts' checks followed podcasts by default. Set 'searchCatalog' to true only when the podcast is not followed, since it needs the network. - Playback changes apply asynchronously. Call 'getUpNext' to read the current player state. Constraints: - Search and list results are capped at 20 items. - Playback speed ranges from 0.5 to 5.0. Sleep timers range from 1 to 1440 minutes. - Unfollowing podcasts, clearing Up Next, and deleting downloads are not available.
